newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault head sees record September sales.
newsitem.headline: Renault head sees record September sales.

text.p: French carmaker Renault SA expects to make record sales for September and an increase in its domestic market share by the end of the year, chairman Louis Schweitzer said on Sunday.
"We will have a record month ... without doubt, more than 100,000 Renaults ordered in September, which is a historic record," he told Europe 1 radio.
The company will benefit from orders placed in September as this is the last month in the government's scheme of cash rebates for new cars to replace 10-year old models.
Schweitzer said Renault expects to end the year with a market share in France significantly above 28 percent compared to 26 percent in the first half.
"We fully expect the last quarter to be significantly higher than 28 percent. Thus, a reconquest of market share," he said.
Renault has seen its share eroded this year due to a savage price war in France.
